releases.notes:
## What's Changed
This update adds nested submenus, macros, and a lot of quality-of-life improvements to slot editing and the icon picker.
* Added nested radial menus: a slot can now open a submenu with its own slots. There's also an option to recenter the cursor when a submenu opens or closes.
* Added a "Run Macro" slot mode that chains several actions into one slot. A macro can mix chat messages, commands, keybinds, shortcuts, MaLiLib hotkeys and delays, and you can drag actions to reorder them. A new *Stop All Macros* keybind stops every running macro.
* Added an optional background blur when the radial menu is open, synced with the reveal animation.
* Added a tint color option for icons and glyphs.
* Added Copy, Paste and Reset buttons to the slot editor, so you can share slot setups through the clipboard.
* Added a "Recent" tab to the icon picker. Icons you pick show up there automatically, and you can right-click any icon to favorite it.
* Improved icon picker search and added hints to the slot editor's input fields.
* Added an "Optimize Radial Config" button that permanently removes leftover submenu and macro data from slots whose mode was changed.
* The config screen's live preview now shows the full activation area when the menu background is hidden.
* Added a cubic easing curve to the hover animation.
* Optimized rendering, and improved config validation and sanitization.
* Fixed the blur level resetting when switching submenus.
* Fixed the item icon tab's initial search not working.
* Fixed grid icon tabs not centering properly.
* Added Simplified Chinese (zh_cn) and Indonesian (id_id) translations.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/velolib/radial/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
This is Radial's biggest update yet. After migrating, your radial menus may look different, but by tweaking a couple of settings it's possible to have it look the way you want it to be.
* Redesigned the radial menu with a modern, customizable aesthetic, featuring smooth animations, borders, and invisible activation areas. (note: minor performance impact from visual enhancements).
* Introduced new "Scroll + Click" and "Scroll + Release" activation modes for flexible navigation.
* Renamed existing activation modes for improved clarity and user understanding.
* Added support for Phosphor icons as an optional icon set.
* Optimized caching mechanisms for textures, glyphs, and the icon browser.
* Refactored and cleaned up the Icon Picker codebase for better maintainability.
* Upgraded all scrollable menus to use Minecraft's native `ObjectSelectionList`, introducing visible scrollbars for enhanced accessibility.
* Added dedicated keybindings for activating specific slots, numbered in a clockwise order.
* Standardized project code styling using Palantir Java Format.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/velolib/radial/compare/v3.0.0...v3.1.0

releases.notes:
## User Facing Changes

* Added a new shortcut slot mode to open arbitrary screens (extensible by other mods)
* Replaced the button cycler in the editor with a custom dynamic dropdown menu for slot mode selection
* Standardized the layout of the Slot Editor screen
* Added a scaling effect to slots during the radial menu reveal easing animation
* Fixed the radial menu donut antialiasing to scale correctly regardless of GUI Scale settings
* Fixed a bug where the config version was failing to migrate during updates

## Developer and Technical Changes

* Added an API entrypoint via Fabric loader to allow other modders to register custom modes and shortcuts
* Restructured the entire codebase into a registry based architecture for better consistency
* Standardized all arbitrary string values in the config to use proper Minecraft Identifiers
* Improved translation keys and internal developer naming conventions for better clarity
* Removed legacy code and reorganized base packages


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/velolib/radial/compare/v2.2.1...v2.3.0
